sermons.title: Sermon 162 | The First and Great Commandment

scripture.verse: Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind, and with all thy strength: this is the first commandment.
Therefore let us not sleep as do others, but let us watch and be sober.
As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
He heard the sound of the trumpet, and took not warning; his blood shall be upon him.
That through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is the devil

sermons.title: Sermon 167 | The Holy Spirit and the One Church

scripture.verse: These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit.
Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.
Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to-day, and for ever.
